findings.title: File could not be parsed
findings.rationale: An unparseable or unrecognised file is not audited. Silence here would be a false 'clean' result, so it is reported explicitly.
findings.remediation: Fix the syntax error (`python -m json.tool FILE` or `python -c "import tomllib,sys;tomllib.load(open(sys.argv[1],'rb'))" FILE` shows the position); until then no rule has evaluated this file.
